question: Who comes to the Lord without doubt by declaring this secret?
premises: supreme secret is declared among devotees
supreme devotion to the Lord is made
the declarer attains being filled with the Lord
this is a rule not mere praise
inference: Declaring this secret among devotees with supreme devotion leads to the Lord without doubt.
plain_english: Whoever declares this supreme secret among devotees, making supreme devotion to the Lord, comes to the Lord without doubt.
